newsitem.title: USA: Airbus A3XX to be priced at $198 mln -WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Airbus A3XX to be priced at $198 mln -WSJ.

text.p: Airbus Industrie will price its proposed 550-seat A3XX superjumbo jet at $198 million, a company senior official said.

In an interview published in the Wall Street Journal on Tuesday, Airbus Senior Vice President John Leary said the company had begun presenting its plans for the new jet like price and delivery dates to airlines around the world.
Leary said Airbus expected to start delivering the jet by 2003.
He said the company also hoped potential clients will postpone plans to order new 747 models being built by rival airplane maker Boeing Co.
